claim: 引入遮挡感知建模（上下文组合网络或检测头插件）后，部分遮挡目标的 AP 增量大于 0，且遮挡子集的 AP 增量大于非遮挡子集的 AP 增量。

plan.data: COCO（按遮挡程度分桶）与 CrowdHuman（拥挤遮挡基准）
plan.method: 同一检测器加/不加载入式遮挡感知模块（compositional 或 tri-layer plugin 式），各 3 个随机种子；按遮挡程度分桶报告 AP 增量

decision_criteria.supports: 遮挡感知建模改善部分遮挡目标的检出
增益集中在被建模的遮挡子集（机制归因成立）
decision_criteria.weakens: 增益与非遮挡子集无异，机制解释不成立

alternatives: 增益来自模块带来的参数量/感受野增加，等参数基线即可追平
遮挡增益被可见目标上的损失抵消，整体 AP 无变化

citations.quote: In this work, we propose to overcome two limitations of CompositionalNets which will enable them to detect partially occluded objects: 1) CompositionalNets, as well as other DCNN architectures, do not explicitly separate the representation of the context from the object itself.
To this end we make the following four contributions: (1) We propose a simple 'plugin' module for the detection head of two-stage object detectors to improve the recall of partially occluded objects.
